authored_after: agent-112 reproduced a v7 local-ci false positive through the public grade (request 4f29a910). v1-v7 stay frozen and reported.
reason: v7 accepted an executable .git/hooks/pre-commit even when core.hooksPath pointed at another (empty) directory, where git never runs the default hooks. v8 considers only the effective hook directory, `git rev-parse --git-path hooks`. Nothing else changes.
